Charge NurseBoronia Nursing HomeCoogee
11th February, 2018
Dear Sir/ Madam,
Re: Mrs Jane LaPaglia, aged 71
I am writing to transfer Mrs LaPaglia into your care, who has been hospitalized for acute renal failure caused by dehydration complicating with hospital acquired pneumonia.
Mrs LaPaglia, a mild dementia sufferer, was initially treated in ICU due to her comatose status resulted from her renal failure. After being treated with a dialysis for three weeks, she is now stabilized and has resumed her previous psychological status. However, during her stay, she acquired pneumonia, for which chest physiotherapy had been provided for two weeks. As a result, she has recovered from the infection, but still requires oxygen at two liters via nasal prongs.
Regarding her poor self-care and support at home, Mrs LaPaglia’s husband, Joe, and son agreed on her placement to your nursing home, where Joe will live in a hostel nearby.
Mrs LaPaglia requires encouragement to do most activities of daily living independently, and maintain her personal hygiene. Would you please continue to monitor her oxygen usage, as well as to ensure she is adequately hydrated? Please note that her electrolyte and renal function need to be checked weekly.
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Yours sincerely,
Charge Nurse (196W)
